name: Structuring below reporting threshold
description: Repeated transactions near but below a reporting threshold require contextual review.

name: Intermediary account network
description: Funds move through intermediary accounts toward a collector or onward destination.

name: Cycle-based flow
description: Directed transaction flow returns to the originating account.

name: Abnormal fan-in/fan-out
description: Multiple sources converge on an account followed by dispersal to multiple destinations.

name: Rapid movement of funds
description: Incoming funds leave the account within a short time window.

name: High-risk jurisdiction exposure
description: Transaction activity involves a jurisdiction classified as higher risk by policy.

name: Third-party nominee account
description: Observed use appears inconsistent with the registered account holder context.

name: Virtual-asset linked flow
description: Funds move between bank accounts and virtual-asset services.

name: Trade value inconsistency
description: Trade payment values are inconsistent with supported commercial context.

name: Customer-profile mismatch
description: Observed transaction behavior is materially inconsistent with the declared customer profile.
